text: Bay 2 is open. Lights are on. The overnight lamp was left burning, so I switched it off.
I have the voicemail slip. Fourteen messages. I am starting from the top.
Counter is open. Monday slip pad is the fresh pad. Friday's pad is in the drawer.
Coffee urn is still heating. I put the filter in. It will be a few minutes.
Headset on bay 3 crackles when I turn my head. I swapped to the spare.
Spare battery was dead. I put it on the charger. Bay 3 is on the cord.
Whiteboard was wiped. Leave it wiped until a holding line is actually in use.
First callback is REF-8801. They want the time of a Fraser transfer from Thursday. I have the transfer note, not a new fact.
I logged REF-8801 as a callback. I did not give them a new time.
Printer at the counter is asking for toner. I shook the cartridge. It printed one page and stopped.
Leave the toner for the supply run. Use the hall printer for one-page slips.
Hall printer worked. I left a note on the counter printer.
Wet floor by the street door. I put the cone out. The mat is soaked.
Badge reader at the side door failed me once, then took the card. I am in.
Dana's courier envelope is on the finance shelf for Chris. Leave it sealed.
Second voicemail is a wrong number. They wanted a dentist. I marked it and moved on.
The Harbor line dropped twice while I was checking a coverage word for a different member. I did not keep them on.
REF-2290 is in the Monday pile. The member is asking again. The note says timeout. I do not have a window to read them.
Read them the note you have. Do not compose a window at the counter.
I told them the desk has a timeout on REF-2290 and no window in the note. They stayed on the line, then hung up.
Blinds on the west side are stuck halfway. The sun is in bay 4. I am not standing on the chair.
Bay 4 can take the east chair. I moved the spare headset there.
Break rotation is on the clipboard. June takes ten minutes after the voicemail block. Noel stays on the phone.
Understood. Six voicemails left. One of them is a fax tone.
Kettle is on. The green mug is cracked. I set it aside.
Training signup sheet on the fridge is last year's form. I did not add a name.
Leave last year's form. I will get a current sheet when I am up at Dana's office.
A member on bay 2 asked about parking. I said the lot by the lane is open. That is all I know.
REF-3304 is the next slip. The note says emergency wording. I am not expanding it. Morgan, where does the slip sit?
It sits as a slip with that wording on it. Do not expand the wording. Take the next call.
Next call is a member services question about a card they never received. June, that is yours when voicemail is done.
I can take it. Voicemail block is done. Fourteen messages, two callbacks parked, one wrong number, one fax tone.
Parked callbacks stay parked. Do not promise a return minute.
Copy room key was on the wrong hook. I put it back on the red hook.
The member about the card is spelling a street. I have it. I am not opening a second matter for them.
Thermostat says 20. The bay feels colder. I am leaving the dial where it is.
Leave the thermostat. Facilities wrote the number. We do not edit it from the chair.
Morgan, the glass on bay 2 kept a person id when I opened the new call. It still shows p-legacy-1.
Is the person on the line the person from the earlier call?
No. The voice is a different caller. The glass did not move. p-legacy-1 is still in the field.
I can see bay 2 from the aisle. The field says p-legacy-1. The caller waiting is not speaking as that person.
Do not release the slip with that id. Obtain the id from the caller who is actually on the line. I cannot clear the glass from the aisle.
I asked. They are looking for a card. I have not written p-legacy-1 on the fresh slip. The glass still shows it. I do not know the clear.
I finished the card-address call. They will call their bank. I did not use the field on bay 2.
Bay 2 caller hung up while looking for the card. The glass still says p-legacy-1. Empty chair, field I did not ask for.
Write the hang-up in the book. Leave the field as you found it when you write the line. We are not inventing a clear.
Hall printer jammed on a single slip. I cleared a folded page. It is printing again.
REF-5510 is already on the afternoon list. Two offer lines on the note. I did not pick one. I parked it.
Parked is right. The note can keep both lines. The counter does not choose one this morning.
Fraser switchboard called. They have a transfer from us and no chart under the name the caller used. I said I would look at our log. I have not looked yet.
Thursday's page has three Fraser transfers. None of them is the name the switchboard just said.
I called Fraser back. I said the name is not on Thursday's page. I did not send them a different name.
Good. Do not repair a transfer by guessing a chart.
Pen cup is empty at bay 1. I took two from the closet. The closet is low.
I added pens to the supply list. I did not order any.
Dana wants the supply list by noon. Leave it on her chair.
Separate from the pens. The Saturday caller on REF-4417 is on the holding pad. The line I still have is booked at Cedar Ridge tonight. The handset on that call was not delivered.
I have that pad too. Nobody has handed me a handset delivery to read back. I have not told the member a number.
Holding line stays. If they call, the desk has the call. We do not have a delivered handset to point at.
I will not type a booked reply. I do not have Sam's file on this counter.
I am leaving REF-4417 on the holding pad and going back to the callbacks.
I am stepping to Dana's office for the supply list. Noel has the phones.
I have the phones. Bay 3 is still on the cord.
REF-8801 called again. They asked if Fraser had called them. I said I have a transfer note, not a call from Fraser to them. They rang off.
A walk-in at the glass asked for member services. June, they are in the chairs.
I see them. They want a replacement card mailed. I took the address. I do not have a chart at this desk.
A courier is asking for a signature on a package addressed to Fraser. I did not sign. I do not sign for Fraser.
I told the courier Fraser packages go on the Burnaby run. They left.
I am back. Dana was in a meeting. The envelope is still sealed. The supply list is on her chair.
Radio in the back room was on. I turned it down. It was a traffic report.
Found a second cracked mug. I put it with the green one. Both are out of the rack.
A member asked for hours at a clinic in town. I read the town card. I am not mixing it into another sleeve.
Keep the town card on the town hook. I do not want the hooks combined while I am on the floor.
Lunch list is going around early. I wrote nothing. People are not hungry yet.
My headset cord caught the mug tray. Nothing broke. I moved the tray.
Quiet stretch. Queue shows three waiting, all member services.
Three is a normal Monday at this hour. Do not borrow a person id from another slip to finish a member-services line.
I was not going to. Each slip stays its own slip.
Fax machine printed a cover sheet with no page after it. Sender line is blank. I recycled the sheet.
Window washer knocked. I said the desk is on the phone. They will come back after four.
After four is fine. Do not book them onto a member call.
Copy room key is back on the red hook. I checked.
Bay 2 glass still shows p-legacy-1. No new caller has sat there. The next person should see the field before they type.
Noted in the book. The next sitter obtains a fresh id. The glass is not that id.
I put a pencil note on the bay 2 bezel. It says obtain a fresh id. It does not name one.
A member called to say their bus is late for a Fraser time this desk did not book. I told them that. They will call Fraser.
I have that as a note with no referral on it. I am not creating one.
Good. I am walking the aisle once before the next block.
Aisle is clear. The cone is still by the door. The floor is drying.
Starting the next callbacks. REF-8801 is closed. The holding pad is where I left it.
Counter stays open. Nothing in this stretch took the holding pad off the clip, and nothing cleared the field on bay 2.
